purpose: Exploratory fixed-rule tests of new price-factor families; no parameter search or daily-report changes
entry: Next trading session open after signal close
exit: Holding-session last close; 2-session holding crosses one night and is not a pure close-to-open strategy
rebalance: Non-overlapping cohorts, fixed evaluationStart phase independently for each holding horizon

split.universe: Contemporaneous TWSE/TPEx ordinary-stock rows; original 61-session indicator eligibility plus 21 actual traded OHLC observations for decomposition

residual.universe: Same eligibility plus 273 actual traded OHLC observations in one resolved price segment and estimable market regression

rules.baseline_split: Rank adjusted 20-session total return descending on split-complete universe
rules.day_momentum: Rank summed 20-session open-to-close log returns descending
rules.night_reversal: Rank summed 20-session prior-close-to-open adjusted log returns ascending
rules.split_combination: Equal average of cross-sectional day-momentum and negative-night-return percentile ranks
rules.baseline_residual: Rank adjusted 20-session total return descending on residual-complete universe
rules.market_residual: Fit stock daily log returns to intercept + TAIEX daily log returns over prior252 sessions ending before signal20; rank signal20 residual sum / training residual SD descending
rules.residual_combination: Equal average of cross-sectional total-return and market-residual percentile ranks

inference: Paired net-return and benchmark-excess-win differences; 10000 circular blocks spanning60 sessions (30/12/3 cohorts for2/5/20-session holdings) only within contiguous pairs; Bonferroni across5 new rules x3 horizons x2 outcomes x3 reported periods=90 comparisons
limitations: Market residual is a daily market-only proxy, not original Fama-French residual momentum replication
2020-2026 has already been examined in this project; 2024-2026 is retrospective period stability only, not clean out-of-sample
No substitution of untradable selections; failed buys stay cash; unresolved exits invalidate cohort; invalid periods cannot be silently chained into CAGR
Gross profit/assets requires historic total assets, TTM gross profit and point-in-time filing data; unavailable accounting inputs must be reported rather than fabricated
This tests price strategies, not incremental filters on the monthly revenue/gross-margin portfolio
